question: B1 FEASIBILITY: can a learned folding model (ESMFold v1) run on this box inside the campaign's 93% RAM band?
verdict: NO. Stop B1. Three independent blockers: (1) RAM: >= 8.5 GB resident before load transients against ~4.4 GB of campaign headroom; (2) dependencies: fair-esm 2.0.0's esmfold needs openfold (absent) and omegaconf (absent); openfold requires nvcc and python <= 3.9 per the fair-esm README, the box is Python 3.13 CPU-only torch; (3) the checkpoints are not on disk and total 8.45 GB to download.

esm2_650M_contact_head_as_a_stand_in.where: esm_features.compute() calls model(toks, repr_layers=[33], return_contacts=True) and caches out['contacts'] (n, n) per sequence; core.data.esm_contacts(seq) serves it; s7/repr_cache/esmcon.npz holds it for all 6,790 training sequences and all 126 targets (s26/results/p_probe_esm.json)
esm2_650M_contact_head_as_a_stand_in.already_inside_the_shipped_prior: core.predict.features: con[i,j], its 4 diagonal neighbours, per-residue contact degree, 3 separation-shell contact masses (13 of the 183 input columns)
esm2_650M_contact_head_as_a_stand_in.what_S17_L23_measured: contact head in-band Spearman +0.116 [+0.047, +0.184] at top-75 (accuracy 0.541); increment over its ESM-free twin +0.050 [+0.005, +0.097]; mostly compactness; none reaches the argmin in any band; as a shortlist it is significantly WORSE than matched random (+0.315 to +0.449); ESM buys a FILTER, not a DISCRIMINATOR
esm2_650M_contact_head_as_a_stand_in.consequence: it is not a folding model (a contact probability map, no coordinates) and it is already consumed by the shipped distogram; B2 cannot be 'use the contact head', it is the shipped input. The cheapest genuine size ladder on this box is esm2_t6_8M (on disk) vs 650M, which s26/p_ladder.py carries as rung esm8m.
